description: List scheduled economic and energy data releases from BLS, EIA, the Fed, OPEC and Baker Hughes over the next 1 to 90 days, in release order (UTC). Use when the user asks when the next EIA inventory report, CPI print, Fed decision, OPEC report or rig count comes out. Actual, previous, consensus and surprise values appear once the API knows them. The answer states the API's calendar coverage, so an empty list is only reported as 'nothing scheduled' when coverage spans the window. Requires an API key; the API applies no plan gate to this endpoint.

importance.description: Only releases of this importance: high, medium or low.

source.description: Only releases from this publisher: bls, eia, fed, opec or baker_hughes.

name: opa_get_macro_releases
title: Get Macro Release Calendar
